observedFailure.test: web/tests/provider-advanced.test.tsx::changing the Bedrock region clears an unsent key and submits the selected native provider without an arbitrary endpoint
observedFailure.symptom: No system/provider/write request; DOM displays saved-configuration-changed conflict with the draft retained.

rootCause: The first resource.data commit exposed ModelCatalog and enabled the editor before the passive hydration effect assigned baseRevision and synchronized the input values.
A change event at this observable DOM commit sets dirty.current=true while baseRevision.current is still undefined.
The hydration effect then takes its dirty branch and compares the sole fixture revision r with undefined, incorrectly setting conflict=true. Save is blocked before Api.mutate or any write RPC.

The same editor was also enabled while the initial read was pending. Constant revision r and zero writes rule out actual external revision changes and mutation receipt validation as the cause of the observed failure.

Ordinary isolated reruns, including 100 repetitions, passed and therefore did not constitute a resolution. A MutationObserver at the first exposed editor commit deterministically reproduced the same conflict without sleep or retries.
